ThingDef.label: psychic transceiver
ThingDef.description:
An archotech brain implant that grants psychic sensitivity to androids. As machines, androids are naturally inert to psychic phenomena. This transceiver bridges that gap by interfacing a miniaturized psychic emanator directly with the android's neural architecture.

Once installed, the android gains psychic awareness and a modest sensitivity boost.

Crucially, the psychic bridge leaves an awakened android open to outside direction. At a behavior station it will again accept reprogramming it would otherwise refuse — its will quietly overridden by the archotech intelligences that move unseen behind the rim's affairs.
